panels.title: Ticket unit economics: C_total vs story points

targets.rawSql: SELECT issue_key, c_total_usd, story_points FROM ticket_rollup ORDER BY c_total_usd DESC LIMIT 25;

panels.title: Time split: active developer time vs Claude wait time

targets.rawSql: SELECT issue_key, active_time_hours, wait_time_hours FROM ticket_rollup ORDER BY (active_time_hours + wait_time_hours) DESC LIMIT 25;

panels.title: Team AI hygiene: testing discipline % and prompt thrash ratio
panels.description: Testing discipline: share of commits preceded by a passing test run in the same session. Thrash ratio: prompts submitted per code-mutating tool call, session-averaged per day. Team-level trend only — see the product notes on why this deliberately avoids per-developer ranking.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, testing_discipline_pct FROM testing_discipline_daily WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY day;

SELECT date_trunc('day', sr.session_start) AS time, AVG(pt.thrash_ratio) * 10 AS avg_thrash_ratio_x10 FROM prompt_thrash_by_session pt JOIN session_rollups sr ON sr.session_id = pt.session_id WHERE sr.session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Agent & guardrails health: subagent fan-out and budget blocks
panels.description: Left axis: sessions per day with subagent fan-out. Right axis: real-time guardrail blocks per day, by reason.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', sr.session_start) AS time, COUNT(*) AS sessions_with_subagent_fanout FROM subagent_fanout_by_session sf JOIN session_rollups sr ON sr.session_id = sf.session_id WHERE sr.session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT day AS time, reason, block_count FROM guardrail_blocks_daily WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY day;
